496:t_2:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Anything beyond that is those two's business. Let's wait for the outcome.」

496:t_2:16.en:
$$ミネバ$$
($$シャア$$ is trying to face his own karma, too...)

496:t_2:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(Then I will fulfill my own duty as well. So that he will not laugh at me.)

496:t_2:21.en: ～ Outer-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Bridge ～

496:t_2:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「...$$ネオ・ジオン$$ soldiers are surrendering?」

496:t_2:23.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Yes. I believe the exchanges with $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ had no small influence.」

496:t_2:24.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Many of them seem to be soldiers of the so-called $$シャア・アズナブル$$ faction, starting with Ensign $$レズン・シュナイダー$$.」

496:t_2:25.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So quite a few people understand his actions and do not approve of $$フル・フロンタル$$'s methods.」

496:t_2:26.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Even so, the Colonel would deny what he has done...」

496:t_2:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But that is no reason to let him throw his life away.」

496:t_2:28.en:
$$ブライト$$
「There is no end to what that man still has to do for us.」

496:t_2:30.en:
$$オットー$$
「But isn't it dangerous to accept defectors when we can't guarantee the safety of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$...」

496:t_2:31.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand what you're getting at, Captain $$オットー$$.」

496:t_2:32.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「...You mean the possibility of an informant.」

496:t_2:33.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$, what's your take?」

496:t_2:34.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I guess grudges don't go away easily...」

496:t_2:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Even when this is no time to be saying Federation this, $$ジオン$$ that?」

496:t_2:36.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You can say that only because you're on the Federation side, Colonel.」

496:t_2:38.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But unless we overcome that, we will only repeat the history of war.」

496:t_2:40.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Suspicion breeds phantoms... Rather than doubting the soldiers who surrendered, let us consider how to handle things from here.」

496:t_2:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ティエリア$$ and the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ staff intend to raise the level of the optical camouflage and jamming higher than ever.」

496:t_2:42.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Let's reexamine this ship's travel route, too.」

496:t_2:43.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm counting on you, Captain $$ジンネマン$$.」

496:t_2:44.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I'm sorry for speaking rudely to you earlier.」

496:t_2:45.en:
$$ブライト$$
「No... I made some insensitive remarks myself. I apologize for them.」

496:t_2:46.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I hope you can overcome past feuds with reason, as you two have.」

496:t_2:48.en:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$... What will our next move be?」

496:t_2:49.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We will leave the defense of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ to Captain $$ジンネマン$$ and his men, and go on the offensive.」

$$ブライト$$

$$ＡＧ$$

496:t_10:11.en:

496:t_10:14.en:

496:t_10:15.en:

496:t_10:16.en:

496:t_10:17.en:
